subject: [PATCH nfs-utils v2 7/7] Add MAINTAINERS file and get_maintainer.pl

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a kernel-style MAINTAINERS file to the nfs-utils package, which is used by scripts/get_maintainer.pl to collect To/Cc addresses for patches. The script and MAINTAINERS file are shipped in make dist and new test cases are added to cover the b4 flag sets.
